summary.caveat: Allocation records are not expenditures or verified construction costs. Repeat levels use matching normalized titles and official barangay identity, never proximity; they are review signals, not proof that physical construction occurred. A line naming multiple barangays is associated with each named barangay at its full amount, so barangay totals overlap and must not be added together.
